observations: 20 acceptance cases execute copied real CLI scripts in subprocesses; they do not mock validate_scope or assert prompt regexes.
Negative cases assert nonzero exits and specific pending/stale/invalid/unwired/missing-responsibility codes. Positive cases require all three CLI gates to exit zero.
Both adapter source paths and product-document presence are parametrized in the positive local tests. They assert preexisting file bytes remain unchanged and no concept baseline is fabricated.

The accepted test graph combines implementation/documentation/verification in one node; the independent supervisor fixture instead splits the three responsibilities across dependency-linked nodes with concrete code, docs and verification instructions.
The tests supply explicit agent-produced artifacts; they are meaningful contract/gate tests, not evidence that an actual Claude or Codex planner conducted an interview.

Malformed scope tests exercise invalid areas and boolean revisions, but no acceptance test exercises a malformed workflow nodes container; the independent regression below demonstrates this missing guard.

independent_runtime.fixture_description: Supervisor-authored reservation cancellation contract, unrelated billing direction retained in optional existing product document, independent of acceptance fixture helpers. Three nodes divide implementation/documentation/verification and consume revision 3 with explicit user provenance.
independent_runtime.fixture_generation_and_run_command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import copy, hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path.cwd()
suite=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="t9-supervisor-"))
records=[]
def write(root, rel, data):
 p=root/rel; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text(json.dumps(data))
reqpath=".allforai/bootstrap/local-requirements.json"
ref={"path":reqpath,"id":"cancel-reservation","revision":3}
requirement={"id":ref["id"],"revision":3,"scope":["reservations"],"goal":"Let an owner cancel an unstarted reservation","business_rules":["Only its owner can cancel","Started reservations cannot be cancelled"],"acceptance":["Non-owner cancellation returns forbidden","Started reservation is unchanged","Owner can cancel before start"],"status":"confirmed","confirmation":{"source":"user","reference":"synthetic user response 4: only the owner before start","decision_id":"reservation-owner-3","reason":"Prevent others disrupting reservations"}}
profile={"task_goal":"Add owner cancellation before reservation start","task_route":"local-change","task_scope":{"areas":["reservations"],"requirement_refs":[ref]}}
nodes=[]
for name,role,deps in [("cancel","implementation",[]),("cancel-docs","documentation",["cancel"]),("cancel-verify","verification",["cancel","cancel-docs"])]:
 nodes.append({"node_id":name,"goal":role+" for owner reservation cancellation","capability":"implement" if role=="implementation" else "quality-checks","requirement_refs":[ref],"decision_inputs":[reqpath],"responsibilities":[role],"hard_blocked_by":deps,"exit_artifacts":[".allforai/bootstrap/"+name+"-report.json"]})
body="""
## Attention Contract
- Primary outcome: owner cancellation before reservation start.
- Non-goals / out-of-scope: payment and existing inventory remain unchanged.
- Must-read inputs: local-requirements.json cancel-reservation revision 3, synthetic user response 4.
- Optional inputs: docs/reservations.md.
- Context budget: reservations.py and cancellation test inputs only.
- Quality questions: do non-owner and already-started requests leave state unchanged?
- Stop conditions: return a blocker when confirmed requirement input is unavailable.
- Repair targets: cancel owns implementation repair; cancel-docs owns docs; cancel-verify reruns tests.
## Implementation and Documentation
Update reservations.py cancellation handler and docs/reservations.md ownership/error contract.
## Quality Acceptance
Execute python3 -m unittest test_reservations; inspect owner, non-owner, and started reservation results.
"""
def setup(host,docs=False):
 root=suite/(host+("-docs" if docs else "-no-docs")); root.mkdir()
 scripts=root/".allforai/bootstrap/scripts"; scripts.mkdir(parents=True)
 src=repo/host/"meta-skill/scripts"
 for name in ("validate_bootstrap.py","validate_unattended_readiness.py","check_artifacts.py","product_intent.py"):
  shutil.copy2(src/"orchestrator"/name,scripts/name)
 shutil.copy2(src/"check_decision_inputs.py",scripts/"check_decision_inputs.py")
 write(root,".allforai/bootstrap/bootstrap-profile.json",profile)
 write(root,reqpath,{"requirements":[requirement]})
 write(root,".allforai/bootstrap/workflow.json",{"nodes":nodes,"transition_log":[]})
 for n in nodes:
  p=root/".allforai/bootstrap/node-specs"/(n["node_id"]+".md");p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  p.write_text("---\n"+json.dumps(n)+"\n---\n"+body)
 write(root,".allforai/bootstrap/unattended-run-readiness-spec.json",{"version":1,"run_mode":"unattended","forbid_mid_run_user_prompts":True,"forbid_hidden_fallback_completion":True,"max_repair_attempts":3,"required_capabilities":[],"required_repair_loops":[],"long_task_policy":{k:True for k in ["file_based_handoff","polling","timeout","retry","resume"]}})
 (root/"reservations.py").write_text("def reservations(owner): return []\n")
 if docs: write(root,".allforai/product-concept/product-concept.json",{"vision":"Retain booking service direction","unrelated":["billing"]})
 return root
def run(root,case, expected):
 before={str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in str(p) and "unattended-run-readiness." not in p.name}
 for name in ["validate_bootstrap.py","check_decision_inputs.py","validate_unattended_readiness.py"]:
  cmd=[sys.executable,str(root/".allforai/bootstrap/scripts"/name),str(root/".allforai/bootstrap" if name=="validate_bootstrap.py" else root)]
  if name=="validate_unattended_readiness.py":cmd.append("--write-report")
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,env={**os.environ,"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE":"1"})
  rec={"case":case,"root":str(root),"command":cmd,"cwd":str(root),"stdout":r.stdout,"stderr":r.stderr,"exit":r.returncode,"expected_exit":expected}
  if name=="validate_unattended_readiness.py":
   report=root/".allforai/bootstrap/unattended-run-readiness.json"
   rec["persisted_report"]=json.loads(report.read_text()) if report.exists() else None
  records.append(rec)
 after={str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in str(p) and "unattended-run-readiness." not in p.name}
 assert before==after,(case,"authority/source modified")
for host in ["claude","codex"]:
 for docs in [False,True]:
  root=setup(host,docs)
  run(root,"confirmed-local-"+host+("-docs" if docs else "-no-docs"),0)
 root=suite/(host+"-no-docs")
 pending=copy.deepcopy(requirement);pending["status"]="pending";pending.pop("confirmation")
 write(root,reqpath,{"requirements":[pending]});run(root,"pending-"+host,1)
 write(root,reqpath,{"requirements":[requirement]});run(root,"restored-"+host,0)
 malformed=copy.deepcopy(profile);malformed["task_scope"]["requirement_refs"][0]["revision"]=True
 write(root,".allforai/bootstrap/bootstrap-profile.json",malformed);run(root,"invalid-revision-"+host,1)
 write(root,".allforai/bootstrap/bootstrap-profile.json",profile)
 changed=copy.deepcopy(requirement);changed["revision"]=4;changed["status"]="pending";changed["goal"]="Permit every staff member to cancel"
 write(root,reqpath,{"requirements":[requirement,changed]});run(root,"changed-pending-"+host,1)
 write(root,reqpath,{"requirements":[requirement]})
 for route in ["new-product","product-reconstruction"]:
  p=copy.deepcopy(profile);p["task_route"]=route;p["task_scope"]["requirement_refs"]=[]
  write(root,".allforai/bootstrap/bootstrap-profile.json",p);run(root,route+"-"+host,1)
 write(root,".allforai/bootstrap/bootstrap-profile.json",profile)
 write(root,".allforai/bootstrap/workflow.json",{"nodes":None})
 run(root,"malformed-nodes-"+host,1)
print(json.dumps({"fixture_root":str(suite),"records":records}))

blocking_findings.title: Guard workflow shape before the new scope scan so readiness still publishes typed failure
requirement_basis: program-spec.md State/failure: validate malformed/ambiguous contracts visibly; no empty/default success; preserve exact diagnostic
tasks/intent.md T9 Failure contract: typed visible pending/stale/invalid/conflict/error
reviews/failure-classification.json O1 invalid-input guard: rejected input followed by corrected scoped reentry
blocking_findings.trigger: A generated workflow is valid JSON but has nodes:null. The existing readiness validator already recognizes non-list nodes and adds missing_workflow, but the new call passes the original malformed workflow to validate_scope.
blocking_findings.actual: validate_scope's any(...) executes before its try/except and raises TypeError. Readiness exits 1 with empty stdout and a traceback before --write-report runs. If an earlier report was ready, it remains byte-for-byte ready. Bootstrap likewise loses its normal structured diagnostic to the same new helper crash.
blocking_findings.expected: Return/publish a current not_ready report with a typed malformed-workflow/scope blocker and retain source/approved requirement records; correcting the workflow should restore readiness.
blocking_findings.fixed_base_comparison: The exact fixed-base readiness script on the same malformed fixture exits 1, prints and writes status:not_ready with code:missing_workflow and message:'workflow.json nodes must be a list'.
repro_steps: Run the independent fixture command in independent_runtime.fixture_generation_and_run_command.
On claude-docs, run copied validate_unattended_readiness.py <project> --write-report to establish ready.
Save workflow.json bytes; replace its content with {"nodes": null}; rerun the same command.
Observe empty stdout, TypeError in stderr, exit 1 and unchanged ready report. Compare the fixed-base script via git show as in regression_reproduction_command.
Restore the saved workflow and rerun; candidate is ready again.
blocking_findings.scope_note: This is a regression introduced in T9's common helper integration, not a demand for T10-T18 behavior. Preexisting check_decision_inputs malformed-container failure is not counted as a second new finding.
blocking_findings.suggested_repair: Validate workflow/node container types before scanning and route malformed values through the existing typed blocker path; add a focused copied-CLI regression including prior-ready report and corrected reentry. No repair was performed.
